clue.text: Section of church left out by accident

indicators.note: left out tells us the letter for left is dropped from the church section

parts.note: the chancel is the part of a church around the altar

explanation.surface: Someone stumbled into part of a church without meaning to.
explanation.definitionFit: Chance and accident are synonyms: something happening by luck rather than design.

clue.text: Murderer receiving retribution, principally a heap of stones

indicators.note: receiving says the murderer's name takes another letter inside it

parts.note: Cain killed his brother Abel in Genesis

indicators.note: principally points to the leading letter of retribution

explanation.surface: A killer gets punishment, mainly a pile of rocks.
explanation.definitionFit: A cairn is a mound of stones raised as a marker or memorial.

clue.text: Disbelief that two articles are supported by one manuscript that happened to turn up

indicators.note: in a down clue, supported by puts the following pieces beneath

parts.note: A and THE are the indefinite and definite articles, side by side
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: in a down clue turning up means reading upwards, so the letters are reversed

explanation.surface: Disbelief that a document showing two articles just turned up.
explanation.definitionFit: Atheism is the lack of belief in any god, a specific kind of disbelief.

clue.text: Chips for Karen

definitions.meaning: Chips is the traditional nickname for a ship's woodworker
Karen of the singing duo the ...

explanation.surface: Fries for a woman named Karen.
explanation.definitionFit: Chips is slang for a woodworker, who chips wood, and Karen Carpenter sang with her brother Richard.

clue.text: Siphon off from tin detective held

indicators.note: held says the detective's letters grip the tin's letters between them

parts.note: a can is a tin container

explanation.surface: A detective is drawing liquid out of a tin he is holding.
explanation.definitionFit: To decant wine or liquid is to pour or siphon it off from one vessel into another.

clue.text: Gray's started off with the curfew

definitions.text: Gray's started off with the curfew

parts.words: Gray's started off with the curfew
parts.note: Thomas Gray's famous poem on a country churchyard opens with the line The curfew tolls the knell of parting day

explanation.surface: Someone named Gray began with the evening curfew.
explanation.definitionFit: Gray's Elegy Written in a Country Churchyard is a mournful poem whose first words are The curfew.

clue.text: Just the opposite in paean to nymphs

indicators.note: in says the letters lie inside the words paean to nymphs

explanation.surface: A hymn to nymphs says the very reverse.
explanation.definitionFit: An antonym is a word of opposite meaning, such as hot for cold.

clue.text: Rate revision certainly right for money man

indicators.note: revision means reworking, so the letters are put in a new order

parts.note: sure is used as an informal certainly

explanation.surface: Revising the rate is surely the job of the finance officer.
explanation.definitionFit: A treasurer is the officer in charge of an organisation's funds.

clue.text: Trained rather scary kid to become a drummer

indicators.note: trained suggests reshaping by drilling, so these letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A rather frightening child was coached into becoming a drummer.
explanation.walkthrough: Richard Starkey is the real name of Ringo Starr, drummer of the Beatles.
explanation.definitionFit: Ringo Starr, born under this name, played drums for the Beatles: a specific example of a drummer.

clue.text: Fabulous group caught some insects

indicators.note: caught in the sense of heard, so the group's name is taken as it sounds

parts.note: the Beatles were nicknamed the Fab Four, the fabulous group

explanation.surface: A fabled band trapped a few bugs.
explanation.walkthrough: The Beatles were known as the Fab Four; their name and the insects are pronounced alike.
explanation.definitionFit: Beetles form a large order of hard-winged insects, so some insects covers them.

clue.text: Organ fund for refurbishing of port

parts.note: the liver is a body organ
a pool is a shared fund, here one collected for repairs

explanation.surface: Money for restoring the organ of a seaport church.
explanation.definitionFit: Liverpool is a major English port city on the Mersey estuary.

clue.text: Issue of BSE hampered defensibility of dodgy liaison

indicators.note: hampered suggests the letters are tangled up, so they are rearranged
issue as an exit or outflow: the letters B, S and E go out of the long word first

explanation.surface: An outbreak of mad cow disease undermined someone's ability to defend themselves.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove B, S and E from DEFENSIBILITY, leaving DFNIILITY, and 'hampered' scrambles those letters. BSE is bovine spongiform encephalopathy, mad cow disease.
explanation.definitionFit: An affair outside a relationship is unfaithfulness, a shady liaison.

clue.text: Its egg is supposed to sustain you for a very long time

definitions.text: Its egg is supposed to sustain you for a very long time

parts.words: Its egg is supposed to sustain you for a very long time
parts.note: savings put aside to provide for the future, the thing whose egg this is

explanation.surface: Some egg is meant to keep you fed for ages.
explanation.definitionFit: A nest egg is money saved to support someone for years, so the thing whose egg it is fits the clue.

clue.text: Grant for Bill to attend American university

parts.note: a bill is an advertisement, AD
MIT is the Massachusetts Institute of Technology

explanation.surface: A grant lets Bill go to college in the States.
explanation.definitionFit: To grant a point is to concede or acknowledge it, a synonym.

clue.text: A pelmet husband installed; too much and too sudden

indicators.note: installed says one letter is fitted into the curtain word

parts.note: a valance is a short drapery over a window, like a pelmet

explanation.surface: A husband fitted a curtain cover; it all came down at once.
explanation.definitionFit: An avalanche is figuratively an overwhelming sudden rush, like a flood of letters.

clue.text: Sis neglected to re-emphasise arrangement of a transient nature

definitions.note: ephemera are things of short-lived interest, having a passing nature

indicators.note: arrangement of a set of letters means putting them in a fresh order
neglected says the letters of Sis are left out of the longer word

explanation.surface: A sister forgot to stress something again, about things that do not last.
explanation.walkthrough: Take S, I and S out of REEMPHASISE to leave REEMPHAE, which 'arrangement' scrambles.
explanation.definitionFit: Ephemera are items meant to last only briefly, such as tickets and posters, so they share a transient character.

clue.text: An ulcer he developed from labour, hard and dangerous

indicators.note: developed means grew into a new form, so the letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: A man got a stomach ulcer from his heavy, risky work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from labour' points to the twelve Labours of Hercules, the source of the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Herculean describes a task needing immense strength and courage, like the hero's Labours.

clue.text: Leave out label initially as an act of snobbery

indicators.note: initially says the label comes first, ahead of leave out

parts.note: a name is a label we give something
to drop something is to leave it out

explanation.surface: Omit the label at the start, a snobbish move.
explanation.definitionFit: Mentioning famous acquaintances to impress others is a classic snobbish habit.

clue.text: Smart style emcompassing (sic), for example, tank top

indicators.note: encompassing, misspelt as the clue's (sic) admits, says the style word surrounds the example

parts.note: elan is dash or flair
EG is the abbreviation of exempli gratia, for example

indicators.note: top in a down clue means the first letter of tank

explanation.surface: A fashionable look takes in, say, a tank top.
explanation.walkthrough: The setter flags the misspelt 'emcompassing' with (sic).
explanation.definitionFit: Smart and elegant are synonyms for stylishly dressed or graceful.

clue.text: Part of a stair is erect

definitions.text: Part of a stair is erect

indicators.note: part of says the letters are a piece of the run a stair is erect

explanation.surface: Some piece of a staircase stands upright.
explanation.definitionFit: The vertical board between two treads is the upright, standing component of a step, as the whole clue says.

clue.text: See 8
Lame pheasant, perhaps

definitions.meaning: a ... leg is a crippled or lame one
pheasants are wild birds shot for sport and food

explanation.surface: A pheasant with a limp.
explanation.definitionFit: A game leg is a lame one, and pheasant is an example of wild birds hunted for sport.

clue.text: Roman agent favouring museum chief

parts.note: pro means in favour of
a curator runs a museum's collection

explanation.surface: An agent of Rome sides with the head of a museum.
explanation.definitionFit: In ancient Rome a procurator was an official agent who managed provincial finances.

clue.text: Appreciate award

explanation.surface: Value the trophy.
explanation.definitionFit: To prize something is to value it, and a prize is an award won.

clue.text: Award points for the very fat

parts.note: the OBE is a British honour, Officer of the Order of the British Empire
S and E are compass points, south and east

explanation.surface: Honours for the heavily overweight.
explanation.definitionFit: Obese means extremely overweight, a synonym of very fat.

clue.text: Marine fixed canoe with integrated circuit

indicators.note: fixed as in repaired, so the letters are reworked into a new order

explanation.surface: A sailor repaired a canoe fitted with a microchip.
explanation.definitionFit: Marine and oceanic are synonyms, both meaning relating to the sea.

clue.text: Malaysian capital in boisterous cheer for jeer-maker

indicators.note: in says the capital's letters sit inside the scrambled cheer
boisterous means rowdy and unruly, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: KL is the common short form of Kuala Lumpur

explanation.surface: In Kuala Lumpur a rowdy cheer turns into jeering.
explanation.walkthrough: Kuala Lumpur is the Malaysian capital; 'boisterous' scrambles the cheer and 'in' places KL inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who heckles shouts jeers and interruptions at a speaker or performer.

clue.text: Respect judge

definitions.meaning: to consider or reckon, as in to hold someone in some view

explanation.surface: Honour the judge.
explanation.definitionFit: Esteem means high regard as a noun, and as a verb to consider or deem.

clue.text: Look separately around New Zealand and Malta for organic catalyst

indicators.note: around says the split word also wraps the island's letter in its second gap
separately says the word for look is split, its letters parted to take one piece between them

parts.note: to eye something is to look at it
M is Malta's international vehicle code

explanation.surface: Search in two places, Kiwi land and Malta, for a biological agent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'separately' and 'around' together mean the look word is split twice, with a different piece in each gap.
explanation.definitionFit: Enzymes are proteins that speed up chemical reactions in living things, making them biological catalysts.
